values.note: State forest drive-in campsite $17 a night, taxes included. Paid online (or at a state park ranger station) on the day of arrival, before occupying a site; no envelopes on site.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-parks/fees.html ('In state forests (taxes are included): Drive-in campsites $17/night') + https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Beginning in 2026, state forest camping fees are paid before you occupy a campsite. Same day advance payment is available on your arrival date'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site or mail-in payments.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: First come, first served; the fee is paid online on the arrival date (no paying ahead for a future date).

booking.source: DNR facility cmp00029 ('Each of the eight campsites has a fire ring, picnic table, access to toilets, and seasonal drinking water. First-come first, served.'; 'All campsites require a fee that must be paid before occupying a campsite. Same-day advance payments available.') + fees-reservations page, read 2026-11-11

values.note: Closed November 22 to May 7, depending on weather; water off and no trash service from November 1 to mid-May.

season.source: DNR facility cmp00029 ('Campground closed November 22 - May 7, 2027, depending upon weather conditions. Water is off for the season. No trash service November 1 - mid-May.'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: DNR facility cmp00029 (camping: campsites 8, accessible 1; 'Each of the eight campsites') + facility map (sites 1-9 shown on one loop), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: DNR facility cmp00029 (water_and_sanitation: toilets 2, wells 1; 'seasonal drinking water') + facility map legend ('Vault Toilet' at two points on the loop), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state forest campground on one small loop beside the Ash River public landing (boat ramp), near Voyageurs National Park's Ash River Visitor Center; managed from Bear Head Lake State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR record cmp00029 + 2023 map read: 8 FCFS sites, $17 tax-included, now paid online on the arrival day (old note's 'paid at the campground' corrected); closed Nov 22 - May 7; vault toilets, seasonal well water. Riverview lead (sites 1-2 across County Road 129). Phone 218-235-2520 (Bear Head Lake SP), DNR link to hyphen form.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade): not waterfront -> riverview. The DNR map puts sites 1 and 2 at the loop's south end next to County Road 129; imagery (around 48.40640,-92.81430) shows them on open mowed grass about 30-40 m from the Ash River (here 100 m+ wide), with only the paved county road and a narrow shoulder between and the water visible across it. The public road rules out riverfront. Site 9 on the west side is ~50 m from the river backwater through trees (no value).
Phone: none stored -> 218-235-2520 (the DNR names Bear Head Lake State Park as the manager, 'phone: 218-235-2520').
Season added: open ~May 8 - November 21 per the DNR ('Campground closed November 22 - May 7, 2027, depending upon weather conditions').

Fees note corrected: the stored note said the fee is 'paid at the campground'; since 2026 the DNR takes no on-site envelopes and the fee is paid online (or at a state park ranger station) on the arrival day.
